angle: paper drawings feel like a book instead of a camera roll
hook: Paper drawings feel different when they live in a book.
text: Paper drawings feel different when they live in a book instead of a camera roll. This is Buki turning three synthetic drawings into a swipeable sketchbook. Which page style feels most natural? https://buki.expo.app/ #Shipaton #BuildInPublic #IndieDev
question: Which page style feels most natural?

angle: the final empty page must look intentional after reopening
hook: One small page-flip rule caused a lot of edge cases.
text: One small page-flip rule caused a lot of edge cases: the final empty page still has to feel intentional, not broken. I now treat page position as saved state. Where should a reopened book land? #Shipaton #BuildInPublic #ReactNative
question: Where should a reopened book land?

angle: reset only Buki data and replay the same synthetic flow
hook: I reset only Buki's data on one disposable simulator.
text: I reset only Buki's data on one disposable simulator, load synthetic drawings, then capture the same flow again. It makes visual bugs easier to reproduce. What part of a demo should always be deterministic? #Shipaton #BuildInPublic #iOSDev
question: What part of a demo should always be deterministic?

angle: same archive browsed as a book grid or album
hook: The content stays put while the way you browse changes.
text: Buki can show the same little archive as a vertical book, photo grid, or album. The content stays put; only the way you browse changes. Which view would you use most? #Shipaton #BuildInPublic #ProductDesign
question: Which view would you use most?

angle: clean seed data makes weekly publishing dependable
hook: Today's unglamorous work was making the demo repeatable.
text: Today's unglamorous work: a clean demo account, fixed seed data, and a capture run that can be repeated next Saturday. Good build-in-public posts need boring preparation behind them. #Shipaton #BuildInPublic #FounderJourney

angle: replace seed placeholders inside each new simulator container
hook: Local file paths change when an iOS app is reinstalled.
text: Local file paths change when an iOS app is reinstalled. The seed stores a placeholder path, then rewrites it inside the new app container. Have you hit this kind of simulator-only bug? #Shipaton #BuildInPublic #Expo
question: Have you hit this kind of simulator-only bug?

angle: loose paper and forgotten photos need one home
hook: Children's drawings often end up as loose paper or forgotten photos.
text: Children's drawings often end up as loose paper or forgotten photos. Buki is my attempt to make them easy to keep and revisit. What usually happens to drawings in your home? https://buki.expo.app/ #Shipaton #BuildInPublic #ParentingTech
question: What usually happens to drawings in your home?

angle: titles notes favorites and tags stay close to each image
hook: The art library keeps the useful context beside each drawing.
text: The art library groups drawings by sketchbook and keeps titles, notes, favorites, and tags close to the image. Would filters or search help you more first? #Shipaton #BuildInPublic #UXDesign
question: Would filters or search help you more first?

angle: synthetic identity with cloud sync and analytics disabled
hook: The capture build never touches a real family account.
text: The capture build never touches a real family account. It uses an obvious demo identity and synthetic artwork, with cloud sync and analytics left off. That boundary matters more than a polished clip. #Shipaton #BuildInPublic #SoftwareTesting

angle: stop on ambiguity instead of risking duplicate posts
hook: I found a useful rule for browser automation.
text: I found a useful rule for automation: stop when the browser result is ambiguous. A missed post is visible; a duplicate post looks careless. Where would you rather automation stop and ask? #Shipaton #BuildInPublic #MakerJourney
question: Where would you rather automation stop and ask?

angle: report the process without guessing at review status
hook: App Store work is mostly a release process.
text: App Store work is mostly a release process: build, validate, upload, wait, read the result, then fix the next concrete issue. I am keeping Buki posts about that process, not guessing at review status. #Shipaton #BuildInPublic #AppStore

angle: keep nearby pages warm without retaining every decoded image
hook: Image-heavy pages need a small cache that knows when to let go.
text: Image-heavy pages need a small cache, but the cache cannot grow forever. Buki keeps nearby artwork warm and evicts older decoded images. Which matters more here: instant page turns or lower memory use? #Shipaton #BuildInPublic #MobileDev
question: Which matters more here: instant page turns or lower memory use?

angle: keep the original photo and notes with the saved artwork
hook: A saved drawing is more useful when its context stays attached.
text: A drawing can move from a sketchbook page into the art library without losing its original photo or notes. What would you want attached to each drawing? https://buki.expo.app/ #Shipaton #BuildInPublic #KidsArt
question: What would you want attached to each drawing?

angle: repeatability and approval mattered more than another shiny feature
hook: This week was about making the work repeatable.
text: This week was less about adding a shiny feature and more about making the work repeatable: clean data, honest media, duplicate checks, and one approval before scheduling. Next week starts from a better base. #Shipaton #BuildInPublic #WeeklyReview
